audit_name: Full-Catalog Global Calibration Score Discrepancy Resolution
scope: 15,053 series x 4 origins x 13 horizons = 782,756 predictions

v2_2_3_global_calibration.factor_logic: valid_m = base_vol > 0; excluded newly active post-holiday series from numerator

v2_2_4_global_calibration.factor_logic: p_sum / b_sum across all 15,053 series; captures entire portfolio retail drop

mathematical_explanation: v2.2.3 applied valid_m = base_vol > 0 when aggregating holiday transition ratios, excluding series that had zero sales in the 12-week pre-holiday period but positive post-holiday sales. This caused under-summation of post-holiday demand, producing artificially aggressive contraction factors (0.8648 for 2022 and 0.8690 for 2023). That over-contraction exacerbated under-forecasting bias (-0.0291) and resulted in VN1 = 0.5463. v2.2.4 corrected the aggregation to include all catalog series, yielding true macro factors of 0.8991 and 0.8926. This reduced relative bias to -0.0150 and produced VN1 = 0.5342. Both numbers are 100% reproducible and their difference is completely accounted for.
